title: AI Chat — Gemini-Powered Chatbot App with Markdown Rendering
description: A Flutter chatbot app using Riverpod and Google Gemini API. Users send messages and receive AI responses rendered in rich Markdown format.
architecture: Riverpod Notifier Pattern — Controllers handle logic, Services handle API calls, Models hold data, Widgets render UI

features.ai_chat: Single-screen chat UI — user messages (blue, right) and AI responses (grey, left) with auto-scroll
features.gemini_api: REST calls to Gemini API (gemini-flash-latest) via Dio with .env-based API key
features.markdown_rendering: AI responses rendered as rich Markdown (bold, lists, code blocks) using flutter_markdown_plus
features.timestamps: Every message shows time in hh:mm a format
features.loading_indicator: Spinner shown while waiting for AI response
features.error_handling: Graceful handling of network errors and API failures

project_structure.controllers/chat_controller.dart: Manages messages list and loading state
project_structure.screens/ai_screen.dart: Chat UI — message list, input field, send button
project_structure.widgets/message_bubble.dart: Styled chat bubble with Markdown support

app_flow: User types message → ChatController adds it to state → GeminiService calls Gemini API → AI response added to state → UI rebuilds with new message bubble → auto-scrolls to bottom
